symbol.text: Subscribe to a remote list of domains to block or allow.
Nature sets direction; each profile may override it.
Internal short name; lower-case, no spaces.
↹/↑↓ move · ←/→ change · Ctrl+s save · Esc cancel
The name shown in dashboards, stats and logs.
Full https:// address of the list file to download.
Enter shows or hides format, refresh and token.
Block refuses these domains; Allow permits them anyway.
Inactive lists stay on disk but filter nothing.
Change where this list comes from and how Warden treats it.
Nature sets direction; each profile may override it.
